snippet.title: Hands Over - Official Console Announcement Trailer | The MIX Summer Game Showcase 2026
snippet.description: Don't miss the Console Announcement Trailer for Hands Over, a first-person horror co-op card game developed by ArtDock. Players will endure harmless challenges that become cruel tests of luck and nerve. Bluff, sabotage your friends, play dirty, and stay at the table longer than anyone else. Hands Over is coming soon to PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo Switch, and PC (Steam).
